question: Figure 1 shows an incomplete diagram of a DDoS attack. Complete the diagram by adding the Command & Control (C2) server and drawing its connections to the compromised devices.
figure:
flowchart LR
  Attacker([Attacker]) --> GAP[??]
  Device1[Compromised Device] --> Target[Target Server]
  Device2[Compromised Device] --> Target
  Device3[Compromised Device] --> Target
  Target --> Down[Server Overwhelmed / Offline]
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  Attacker([Attacker]) --> C2[Command & Control Server]
  C2 --> Device1[Compromised Device]
  C2 --> Device2[Compromised Device]
  C2 --> Device3[Compromised Device]
  Device1 --> Target[Target Server]
  Device2 --> Target
  Device3 --> Target
  Target --> Down[Server Overwhelmed / Offline]

mark_scheme.instruction: Award up to 4 marks. Award marks for correctly completing/adding the required element(s) to the given diagram.
points: Command & Control (C2) server correctly placed between attacker and devices (1)

Botnet shown feeding traffic into the target server (1)
